title: Brazilian Beef and Zesty Bowl
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional Brazilian beef dishes, this zesty bowl is a flavorful and colorful meal.

ingredients.name: Brazilian zesty rice
ingredients.notes: Use leftover rice if you can

instructions: Cook the Brazilian zesty rice according to package instructions or leftover leftovers.
Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F) and roast the vegetables with a drizzle of oil until tender.
Heat the black beans in a pan with a splash of water until warm.
Mix the chimichurri sauce with red pepper flakes and adjust seasoning.
Assemble the bowls by dividing the rice among plates, topping with roasted vegetables, black beans, sliced avocado, and a fried or poached egg (if using).
Drizzle the chimichurri sauce over the top and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
